item.title: Salón Acme Puts Authenticity at the Center of Its Thriving Art Fair in Mexico City
item.description: Now in its 13th year, Mexico City’s Salón ACME continues to foster new audiences and connect emerging artists with collectors.

item.title: New Studies Suggest That Birdwatching Will Help Boost Brain Health, And Here's Why
item.description: Time to bust out those binoculars and give your brain a boost.

item.title: Explore the Full Breadth of Ai Weiwei’s Creative Practice in This Sweeping Book
item.description: Taschen’s updated and expanded Ai Weiwei monograph compiles 40 years of incredible output.

item.title: The Other Art Fair 2026 Preview: Everything You Need To Know Before It Opens in Brooklyn
item.description: The Other Art Fair is returning to the Agger Fish Building in Brooklyn after a long hiatus. Find out more about what to expect at the event.

item.title: Artist Sews Real Leaves Together to Fashion a Dress That’s Wearable Art
item.description: It took 40 hours of hand-sewing to complete, but the results speak for themselves. Take a look at this stunning dress made of real leaves!

item.title: This Exhibition Exposes Just How Much Art, Technology, and the Human Body Intersect
item.description: Medical imaging tools used to be reserved for doctors, but artists quickly saw the potential in them. This fascinating exhibit explores that intersection of science and art.

item.title: JR’s Large-Scale Installations Are on Display at This Immersive Solo Exhibition in LA
item.description: Visitors can expect JR’s signature large-format photographs of faces and figures, printed across walls, floors, and ceilings, emphasizing the universal human experience and the connections that link communities.

item.title: Artist Paints Found Rocks To Resemble Comfort Foods and Household Objects
item.description: When art materials became too expensive, this artist started picking up rocks and using them as a canvas for her creativity.

item.title: Magnum Photos Print Sale Features Iconic Work of 100+ Photographers for One Week Only
item.description: For one week only, the public has a chance to own a print for a More affordable price.

item.title: This Relaxing Online Class Is a Fun and Educational Way To Make Nature-Inspired Art
item.description: “Enjoying the act of painting is just as important as the outcome!”
